refnamediv.refpurpose: filter to convert BDF fonts to Unifont HEX fonts

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: bdf2hex.pl reads a font in BDF format from its standard input and prints the font in Unifont HEX format to its standard output.

Comments are passed through with the # character turned into a TAB character. Width and height are taken from the FONTBOUNDINGBOX and recorded using the vtfontcvt1 convention. All other BDF metadata are lost, as the Unifont HEX format does not have any other metadata.
